description: THE SITE MAP — the one owner of which host serves which route. Three sites and the apex router, on subdomains of figaroprotocol.com. `routes` is a longest-prefix table: [prefix, [sites]]; the FIRST site listed owns the route for link resolution, the rest carry a copy (a shared surface mounted on more than one host). `/` is matched exactly. Read by lib/shared/sites.ts (links and nav), scripts/split-export.mjs (the export split), and scripts/lint-site-map.sh (every page route must map). `aliases` renames a source route on one host: [sourceRoute, site, servedPath] — the tree holds the page under sourceRoute; that host serves it at servedPath; links to sourceRoute are written as servedPath on that host and as the host's servedPath elsewhere.
